text.card: A red giant 3,825 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.99 solar masses and 7.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,898 K at its surface.
